name: Noite de comédia
description: Noite de comédia is a stand-up comedy show taking place at Era uma vez em Paris in Porto. Admission to the performance is free.
longDescription:
Noite de comédia is a stand-up comedy session held at Era uma vez em Paris, located at Rua da Galeria de Paris, 106.

The performance is scheduled for 10 November 2026, starting at 21:30 and running until 23:00. Entry is free of charge.
